_README: Declares the jmix:mainResource content architecture for this source. mainResource units (news articles, agenda items) are NOT pages — they are content nodes created inside a jnt:contentFolder AFTER media import, then referenced by a listing page's lsp:jcrQuery.startNode. Human-editable. Consumed by orchestration/lib/load_main_resources.py and gated by orchestration/probes/startnode.sh. urlPrefixes are matched against each content-load page's source URL (resolved from the crawl cache tree); listingPages are the sitemap page slugs whose jcrQuery.startNode must point at this folder.
